meta.source: Checkbook NYC API (checkbooknyc.com): Registered Contracts (expense) for the contract universe and a bulk Spending pull filtered at the source by the runtime-discovered spending_category code for dated disbursements, bucketed by contract_id
meta.sweep_strategy: the 2-char spending_category code is DISCOVERED at runtime by sampling the largest in-scope contracts, POSTing Spending per contract_id, and reading the spending_category code on the returned check rows (most common non-empty code wins); the bulk Spending pull is then filtered at the source by that discovered code, paged per fiscal year, deduped on document_id, bucketed by contract_id, kept where the contract is in the construction universe; dated coverage marked only for contracts of at least the amount floor registered since the scope year that are open or closed within the past year
meta.coverage_note: Dated payment timing (the spend curve and velocity) covers construction contracts of $500,000 or more registered since 2019 that are open or closed within the past year, with closure judged by the registered end date. All registered construction contracts remain searchable with their amounts and paid-to-date; paid-to-date and percent paid come from the City's registered-contract record and cover every contract in the index.
coverage_notes: Universe is construction registered contracts (category=expense, status=registered, industry matches construction) registered in FY2021-2025.
Paid to date and percent paid are the City's registered-contract figures (prime_vendor_spent_to_date over current amount) and cover every contract.

Dated payment timing covers construction contracts of $500,000 or more registered since 2019 that are open or closed within the past year (closure judged by the registered end date); their checks come from a bulk Checkbook NYC Spending pull filtered at the source by spending category, bucketed by contract_id and deduped on document_id.
Where a contract is outside that scope, or drew no disbursement, the spend curve and velocity read as a dash; its paid-to-date and percent paid still come from the contract record.
end_date is the contract's SCHEDULED end, not actual completion.
bid_due_date is a best-effort City Record pin join with partial coverage; null where no match.
Velocity denominators use current (registered) amount, falling back to original; days_to_50pct/90pct are null when never reached in the dated stream.
For dated contracts, total_paid is the dated check sum and can differ from paid_to_date; recon_pct reports how closely they agree.
No location/borough field is published for these records by design.
